games.name: Cursed Blade[ALPHA]
games.desc:
Curses speak not a word. They only seep silently into every gap of your sword swings, and into every trophy you claim.There is no destined salvation — only the endless dialogue with the curse, forged time and again by your own hands.

[Game Overview & Features]
◈Over 100 talents to customize your abilities; no two souls are ever identical.
◈Weapons come with dozens of random affixes—no two pieces of gear share the same essence.
◈Dozens of buffs and curses intertwine and counter each other; find your own combat rhythm.
◈No fixed class constraints—your character’s growth is determined solely by your talents and equipped weapons.

[PC & Console Controls]
◉M1: Attack / X Button: Attack
◉Shift: Dash & Roll / R2 Trigger: Dash & Roll
◉Ctrl: Unlock mouse cursor
◉Q: Skill 1 / B Button: Skill 1
◉F: Skill 2 / Y Button: Skill 2
◉R: Skill 3 / L2 Trigger: Skill 3

Currently in Alpha – We roll out weekly updates and welcome your feedback!

games.desc:
Tower FL is a tower obby with randomly generated stages. There are no checkpoints! Can you race other players to the top?

Win coins for every stage you finish. Use your coins to open boxes in the shop and see how many cool cosmetics you can get, Can you collect them all?

VIP server owners can use the settings menu to skip rounds, change the tower size, and lock the shop and commands in chat here:
/skip to skip tower
/setlength (number of stages 4-200) to set how many stages you want
/lock or /unlock to lock the shop
